summary: Guardian Metal Resources PLC filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release providing an operational update on its Tempiute Tungsten Project. The update discusses the identification of historical mine tailings covering ~550 acres, a planned auger drilling program for June 2026, and an expansion of mineral rights by staking 193 claims. No transaction, tender offer, activist campaign, or special-situations event is announced. The filing is a routine operational update from a foreign private issuer, not constituting a special situation under event-driven categories.
